articles.summary: Net Sales Increased 8.5%, Driven by New Stores and Comparable Store Sales Growth of 5.9% in the U.S. and 1.5% in Canada ThriftIQTM Rollout Expanded to 108 Stores; Company Launches Next Phase of Innovation with Patent-Pending Autotagger and Image Capture Company Updates Fiscal 2026 Outlook Savers Value Village, Inc. (NYSE: SVV) (the “Company”) today announced financial results for the thirteen weeks ended October 3, 2026 (the “third quarter”). Financial highlights for the third quarter (comparisons are to the thirteen weeks ended September 27, 2025) Total Company net sales increased 8.5% to $463.1 million; constant-currency net sales 1 increased 8.9%; and comparable store sales increased 4.2%. For the United States (“U.S.”), net sales increased 12.2% and comparable store sales increased 5.9%. For Canada, net sales increased 2.5%; constant-currency net sales 1 increased 4.3%; and comparable store sales increased 1.5%. Net income was $23.4 million, or $0.15 per diluted share. Net income
